My dance teacher told me, Failure is part of growing. Keep practicing, and you'll get over it. So I practiced every afternoon after school. I watched others carefully and asked them for help. After two months, I could dance well. I've learnt that: never fear difficulties. With hard work and courage, we can do anything well and grow stronger.

What's more, her team planned a virtual trip to space. I tried wearing a pair of virtual glasses, and I saw an amazing view. Her job shows how technology makes work creative. I've learnt that new skills help us do amazing things.
